name: Michael Gahler - Après le § 31 - Am 14
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 31a. Expresses its grave concern about the potential budgetary repercussions of Ukraine’s accession for the EU, in particular with respect to the common agricultural policy (CAP) and the Cohesion Funds; underlines that enlargement must not be pursued to the detriment of regions already suffering from persistent structural and development disparities, including Southern Italy; insists that any accession process be preceded by a comprehensive impact assessment on the most disadvantaged regions of the EU, with particular regard to those classed as ‘less developed’;
